chat_good: Hey, %s! Seen anything wild out there lately?
I rode out past the hills yesterday. You should've seen the view.
Got any good stories for me?
I chased a skeleton off the north road last night. It ran!
There's a ruined tower east of here. I'm going to climb it.
I slept under the stars again. Best bed there is.
Found a cave with glowing berries. We should go, %s!
My horse threw a shoe on the ridge. We walked home singing.
I've been mapping the forest. Want to see? It's mostly arrows.
A trader told me about a desert temple. I can't stop thinking about it.
You've got the look of someone who's been places, %s.
I got caught in a thunderstorm on the plains. Best day all month!
I crossed the river at the deep part. Don't tell the elder.
Next full moon I'm heading for the mountains. Coming?
Every road leads somewhere new. That's the best thing about roads.
chat_bad: Yeah, yeah. Talk later, I'm restless.
Talk, talk, talk. When do we go somewhere?
I'm saddling up in a minute.
Not in the mood for chit-chat, %s.
Wake me when something exciting happens.
joke_good: Haha, okay, that's going in my book of good ones.
Hah! That's a campfire story if I ever heard one!
Haha! My horse would laugh at that.
Ha! You've got guts telling that one!
Hahaha! I'm telling the whole caravan!
Ha! That's the kind of humour you need on the road.
Heh! Nearly fell off the fence.
That's a good one. Short and sharp, like a sword.
Haha! You should travel with me, keep the nights lively.
joke_bad: That joke died out on the plains, %s.
I've heard better from a zombie.
That joke needs a horse to carry it, %s.
I'll laugh when you tell a better one.
compliment_good: Hah, thanks! You're pretty brave yourself.
Careful, I'll get a big head.
Ha! That's nice to hear from someone who's been around.
Thanks. I earned these scars, you know.
Thanks! I like your boots, by the way.
Thanks. Sun and wind will do that to a girl.
You've got a good eye. For a village type.
Ha! That's the best thing I've heard all week.
Thanks, %s. I'll ride a little taller today.
Heh. Flattery and a fast horse. You've got style.
That's kind. I'll remember it on the road.
compliment_bad: That's a bit soft, isn't it?
Save it for someone who blushes.
Hm. Rehearsed that one, didn't you?
flirt_good: You and me, %s, out on the open road... I like the sound of that.
Heh. You've got guts, I'll give you that.
Maybe I'll let you ride with me.
I'd share my last torch with you, %s.
Come watch the sunset from the ridge with me tonight.
You're the only one who keeps up with me.
If I went exploring, I'd want you watching my back.
Heh. You make my heart gallop.
I've crossed deserts and mountains, but you, %s... you're something else.
Stay by the fire with me tonight?
You're the best thing I've found on any road.
I'd fight a whole raid for you. Just saying.
Let's go somewhere nobody's been. Just us.
You've got that look, %s. The one that makes me want to stay.
Ride with me forever? Okay, at least till dinner.
flirt_bad: You'll have to impress me more than that.
Come back when you've slain a dragon.
That's not how you win an adventurer.
Hm. Try that again after a real adventure, %s.
gift_love: This is perfect for the road!
Ha! This is the best gift I've had in years!
You get me, %s. You really get me!
I'm taking this on my next journey. Thank you!
Oh, this is going to save my life one day!
I love it! Let's go try it out!
Ha! You just became my favourite person!
gift_like: Thanks! Every adventurer needs one of these.
Nice! I'll put it to good use.
gift_neutral: I'll stick it in my pack. Somewhere.
Not sure what I'll do with it, but thanks.
Hm. Could be useful one day.
gift_dislike: Ugh, too sweet. Not my thing.
What am I supposed to do with that, %s?
That's no good on the road.
Do I look like someone who wants that?
Ugh, that'll just slow me down.
That's what you give a house cat.
I'd throw that off a cliff.
hints: Every rider dreams of a saddle of her own... from someone special.
If someone gave me a saddle, I'd ride off into the sunset with them.
A saddle, %s. That's how you'd ask an adventurer to stay.
The one for me will bring a saddle and a plan. I can feel it.
I'd say yes to a saddle. And the person holding it.
Rings are nice. A saddle means 'let's go together'.
Some nights I dream of a saddle with my name on it. Given with love.
Bring me a saddle and I'll ride beside you forever.
Want to know my weakness, %s? A good saddle.
A saddle's a promise of roads to share. That's the one I'm waiting for.
